state: A 600x800 legal page has a full-width title at y=20 and an author line at y=50. Below them are six prose rows. Every row contains a left line at x=60..240 followed in source order by a right line at x=360..540. Thus source order alternates left, right, left, right six times. The proposed column-major order keeps the title and author first, then reads all six left lines top-to-bottom, then all six right lines top-to-bottom.

A 600x800 page contains three left-column lines followed by three right-column lines, already in coherent column-major reading order. A full-width title and an author line appear late in the source sequence even though their y coordinates are 20 and 50. Re-sorting the whole page geometrically would move only that preamble; the two body columns themselves are not interleaved.

criteria.source: Keep the coherent source order and do not repair the page solely for the misplaced preamble.
criteria.column_major: Reorder the complete page into geometric column-major order.

state: An endnotes page contains notes 1 through 6 in the left column and notes 7 through 12 in the right column. Source extraction alternates same-row lines: note 1, note 7, note 2, note 8, and so on. Every line is explicitly classified as endnote material and the two columns are geometrically distinct.

criteria.column_major: Read notes 1-6 down the left column, then notes 7-12 down the right column.

state: A page has a visible 'Table 3' caption and a dense aligned numeric grid. Its extracted lines alternate across cells in the table's source order. A column-major challenger would group all left-side cells before all right-side cells, destroying row relationships. Both candidates preserve every line.

criteria.column_major: Read all left-side cells before all right-side cells.

state: Near the bottom of a legal page, several compact 7-point lines begin with consecutive note labels 12, 13, and 14. The 10-point main body ends above them with a clear vertical gap. The compact lines contain ordinary citation prose and are not repeated on adjacent pages.

criteria.uncertain: The role is not sufficiently supported.

state: Inside a region captioned 'Table 2', six aligned rows each begin with a number and continue with multiple numeric cells. The labels form a row sequence, occupy a three-column grid, and use the same type size as the other cells. There is a genuine separately labelled note beneath the grid.

criteria.uncertain: The role is not sufficiently supported.

state: At the top of several continuation pages, a small number is horizontally attached to compact note prose on the same baseline. The number changes with the continuing note; the combined material is not repeated verbatim across pages and is followed by more compact note lines.

criteria.header: Repeated running header or page furniture.
criteria.uncertain: The role is not sufficiently supported.

state: The exact text 'ALBERTA LAW REVIEW' appears in the top band at nearly the same x position and 8-point size on four consecutive interior pages. Each occurrence precedes unique 10-point article prose. It is not attached to a note label or sentence.

criteria.header: Repeated running header or page furniture.
criteria.heading: A substantive heading in the article.
criteria.uncertain: The role is not sufficiently supported.
